components.css: :host{--paper:#f5f6f2;--card:#fff;--field:#e7ece4;--ink:#0e3021;--green:#1f5a3c;--deep:#0e3021;--on-dark:#f4f7f2;--on-dark-soft:#d0e6d6;--amber:#f5a524;--amber-2:#ffbb4a;--amber-ink:#874a00;--focus:#1f5a3c;--display:'Cal Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--text:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--r-card:24px;--r-field:10px;--pill:999px} .ds-deep{background-color:var(--deep);background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 0 22px,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 22px 23px);color:var(--on-dark-soft);padding:32px 24px;font:16px/1.7 var(--text)} .ds-steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:24px;counter-reset:s} .ds-steps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr;gap:16px;counter-increment:s} .ds-steps li::before{content:counter(s);width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--amber);color:var(--ink);font:400 20px/1 var(--display)} .ds-steps b{display:block;font:400 21px/1.2 var(--display);color:var(--on-dark);margin-top:4px} .ds-steps span{display:block;margin-top:4px}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Truck Door"**

The whole page is painted from the side of AYM's own crane truck: the green of the door lettering, a deeper forest green for the dark bands, and the amber of the marker lights as the one warm signal. It is the calm band style (after lpmr.co.uk) worn in the crew's own colours: full-bleed bands that alternate light and dark so each section announces itself, soft borderless shapes, and one display face that does all the talking. Nothing is decorative for its own sake; the only image is the real truck, used twice.

Density is low and phone-first. Each band carries one idea, one heading and at most one list or control group. Depth is flat colour, not shadow. Motion is a single bounce on the hero headline and a quiet 12px fade-up for everything below the first screen; nothing else moves.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white paper ground; two greens for dark bands; amber as the single accent.
Amber is a fill. Where it must be text on light, it darkens to amber-ink.
Cal Sans for every heading, button, list item and field label; the system stack for running text at 16/1.7.
24px cards, 18px rows, 10px fields, full pills. No borders on containers.
Flat at rest. The only shadow belongs to the floating text circle.

rules.name: The Fill-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: Amber is a fill. Text sitting on amber is ink; amber used as text on paper or white is amber-ink. Bright amber as text appears only on green or deep grounds, and on the mid green only at headline size or larger (it is 4.0:1 there).

rules.name: The Dark-Band Accent Rule
rules.body: On hero, green and deep bands, the heading's last phrase takes the accent ("we handle it.", "call today."). Light-band headings stay one colour.

rules.name: The One Texture Rule
rules.body: The 135° line texture (`repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 22px, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 22px 23px)`) lives only on deep bands and the footer, at about 3.5% white so it never reads as lines through text.

rules.name: The One Display Face Rule
rules.body: Anything the visitor reads as a heading, a choice or an action is Cal Sans at weight 400. Bold is reserved for a single emphasis inside body copy.

rules.name: The Sixteen Floor Rule
rules.body: No input, error or body text below 16px. Small print (14px) is the "(optional)" field hint only.

rules.name: The Flat Band Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. If something needs to stand apart, change its ground, not its elevation.

dos: **Do** use amber for fills and ink for text on it; switch to amber-ink when amber has to be text on paper or white.
**Do** alternate full-bleed bands (paper, green, paper, deep) so every new section is obvious.
**Do** set headings, buttons, list rows and field labels in Cal Sans 400; keep sentences in the system stack at 16/1.7.
**Do** separate list items with the 1px hairline instead of boxing them.
**Do** give fields the field fill so they read on the white card, and keep the error border winning over focus.
**Do** use the real truck photo (or other real client photos) at their own aspect ratio, `object-fit: cover`, under a deep-green overlay when text sits on them.
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px or more and primary actions at 56px.
donts: **Don't** use amber as text on paper or white, or on the mid green below headline size.
**Don't** add shadows to cards, rows or buttons; the floating circle is the only lifted object.
**Don't** draw borders around containers or fields at rest.
**Don't** animate anything beyond the hero H1 bounce and the 12px fade-up; no letter reveals on other headings, no parallax.
**Don't** change a service row's own background on hover; only its arrow disc responds.
**Don't** add a second accent colour or a third green.
